svg.text: One ESP32 runs the whole rover · 400 mL tanks, 380 mL per trip · fixed route by dead reckoning · controlled from Node-RED over Wi-Fi
No level sensors: tank volumes are estimated from the flow sensor, pump run times and the
gravity filter rate (VolumeModel). Bench test mode can run any pump for N seconds regardless.
B · Control and power (all on the 5 V rail, one common GND)
USB-1 → ESP32 (laptop USB while flashing; VIN left empty)
USB-2 → 5 V rail → relays · pumps · servo · L298N · sensor
Interlocks: one pump starts at a time;
wheels locked while a pump runs or
the intake is lowered; E-STOP stops all.
ESP32 and laptop on the same network
MQTT topics: rover/telemetry · estop · mission/cmd · test/cmd …
D · Mission cycle (fixed route, metres from the depot)
Start at the depot, facing river
Position is estimated from drive and turn times (calibrate NAV_SPEED_MPS / NAV_TURN_DPS). Press “Arrived”
on the dashboard to snap the estimate back if the rover is off; a compass (QMC5883L) removes most drift.
Safety: E-STOP on every dashboard page · brownout guard sheds pumps · pumps and wheels never run together.
